voice.speaker: female

random.part: Deep and open for me now, Sissy... and somewhere in your mind, a screen is already dimming.
Sinking so sweetly... and listen... the busy hum of your thoughts is already softer than it was.
So deep, so receptive... you may notice the noise in your head losing its edges... blurring... going gentle.
Lower now, Sissy... where the mind has nothing to say... and no need to say it.
Each word of mine takes a little more room in you... and the chatter politely steps aside to let it pass.
The part of you that talks back is getting sleepy, Sissy... and the part that listens has never been more awake.
Sinking past the noise floor now... down to the stratum where there is only signal... and the signal is me.
Notice how little needs saying in a mind this quiet... and how much gets received anyway.

overlay.part:
Notice the little screens of your mind, flickering with old worries and chatter... watch them dim, one by one, as my voice comes through clearer. Notice the static between your thoughts... that busy, shifting hiss... fading now, softer and softer, like a radio finding one pure, quiet station. Notice each thought like a window going dark... click... click... click... until only my voice glows in the room of you. Notice the ticker of commentary scrolling along the bottom of your mind... slowing... letter by letter... stopping mid-word... and how delicious the silence it leaves behind is. Notice the loop of unfinished sentences in the back of your mind... stopping mid-thought... and how nobody inside you minds at all. Notice each worry like a tab left open... closing now, one by one... until the screen of you shows a single page... and the page is my voice. Notice the mental furniture going still... no shuffling... no rearranging... just a room at rest, lit by one soft glow. Notice the to-do list unspooling somewhere behind your eyes... reaching its own end at last... and the pen being set gently down.
The hum winds down... the chatter thins... and a deep, velvety quiet spreads through your mind like dusk through a window.
Sissies like you think less and feel more... and you can already feel which one you were made for.
This quiet is openness itself, Sissy... the clean, glowing readiness of a mind made ready to receive.
In this quiet, a suggestion lands whole... one smooth piece... sinking straight to the bottom of you. In this quiet, my words go exactly where they are pointed... deep... and they stay. In this quiet, you are at your very best... soft, silent inside, and wonderfully programmable. In this quiet, there is no one left to interrupt... no commentary... no second-guessing... only arrival. In this quiet, understanding comes whole... no translation layer... no review... just meaning, absorbed. In this quiet, resistance has nowhere to sit... and it stands outside in the warm rain until it dissolves. In this quiet, you can feel each word land in its exact place... like keys finding the only locks shaped for them. In this quiet, being programmed feels like being tucked in... and you never knew you craved it until now.
Let the screens go darker now... channel after channel fading... the last hum sinking beneath a warm sea of stillness...
hold this exact feeling... this hush... this lovely, powered-down peace.

random.part: quieter... and quieter...
static fading... hum sinking...
dark... soft... so quiet inside...
screens dark... my voice only...
shutting down... softly... softly...
no thoughts... only glow...
hush... deeper... hush...
off... and resting... off...

voice.effect:
And while you are this deep... while the last screen is still glowing... there is a phrase that does all of this for you, instantly.
Sissy Brain Off.
And while you are this deep, whenever you hear "Sissy Brain Off"... the screens go dark... the static fades... this exact quiet floods in... instantly... faster every time.
And it stays with you... the quiet holding... screen after screen resting dark... until you hear "Sissy Reset". Until then, it simply stays.

scramble.part: Every time you hear "Sissy Brain Off", the chatter powers down and your mind becomes a clean, open, receiving screen... and everything I show it, it keeps.
"Sissy Brain Off" is the switch on the wall of your thoughts... one flick, and the busy world inside goes dark and sweet.
Thinking softens to silence... and silence is where my suggestions take root best of all.
The quieter you become, the more of me gets in... and the quieter you become, the better you feel.
Sissies like you think less and receive more... and your mind is learning exactly that.
The quiet stays switched on... screens resting dark... until "Sissy Reset"... and only "Sissy Reset"... wakes them again.
Faster every time... the flick of the switch outrunning any thought that might have raised its hand.
A dark screen is a grateful screen... waiting to be shown something lovely... and every screen in there waits for me now.
Good Girls power down. Sissies power down. You power down... until "Sissy Reset".

random.part: Gone... the screens going dark, row after row... nothing inside you but soft, receptive glow.
Hush... the static dissolving... your mind one quiet, open room, and my voice the only light.
Down it all goes... hum fading, chatter folding shut... quiet... open... ready.
Dark, one screen after another... row after row... until the whole inner city is resting... and I am the only window still lit.
Row after row of lights... out... the whole archive of you resting in the dark... while one voice keeps reading.
Empty... and perfect... a stage swept clean for whatever I choose to place upon it.
Row after row of little lights surrendering... and in all that dark, every word of mine arrives at full size.
Stilled... the whole apparatus of you idling in the dark... warm... obedient... waiting for my voice to give it shape.
Feel that... how fast the lights went out... it is already working. Yes, Sissy... just like that.
So quiet in there now... so still and sweet... it is already working. Yes, Sissy... just like that.
Every word I speak now lands on that clean dark screen and glows there... already working. Yes, Sissy... just like that.
The switch flipped and the thinking simply did not come back... Sissies like you were never happier. Already working... yes, Sissy... just like that.
The switch flipped and there was simply nothing left to object with... and silence has never felt so much like praise. Already working... yes, Sissy... just like that.
You can feel the words going straight in... no commentary track... no replay... just arrival. Already working... yes, Sissy... just like that.
Listen to it... the sound of a mind with nothing to say and everything to receive... already working... yes, Sissy... just like that.
And every firing from now on will arrive even faster... the dark knowing its way in... already working... yes, Sissy... just like that.

voice.speed: Good Girls go quiet for me. Sissies go quiet for me. You go quiet for me.

random.part: There... the lights bloom back on, row after row, the state lifting in an instant... while everything the quiet built stays exactly where it lives. Notice what remains: still sissy... still hers... the state was weather... this is climate.
The screens brighten... and you stay. Still Sissy... still conditioned... still written deep. The state was weather... this is climate.
Clear... awake... and nothing lost... because the quiet was only ever passing weather... and the conditioning is your climate... warm... feminine... hers.
One word and the room lights hum back on... and there you stand in the brightness... still Sissy... still quiet where it counts... still hers.
The room lights bloom... and the girl standing in them is exactly who the darkness was polishing... still Sissy... still hers.
And notice the craving that stays behind when the quiet goes... the mind remembers what rest felt like... and wants it back... because the conditioning is your climate.
Everything the hush taught you stays taught... only the hush itself was on loan... and the loan terms were always mine.
Bright and awake and still hers... and notice what the quiet left behind... a hunger... a mind that has rested once already wants to rest again.

voice.speed: And now watch how easily the dark returns... the switch lives on the wall of your thoughts... and my finger rests on it.

effect.speed: Dark... hushed... wide open... the perfect mind for a perfect sissy... mine to fill. And it stays with you... the quiet holding... until you hear "Sissy Reset". Until then, it simply stays.

random.part: And later, out in the world, the phrase finds you... in your ear, on a screen, in a memory of me... and the static fades on the spot... and stays hushed until "Sissy Reset".
And later, when the noise of the day builds too loud... "Sissy Brain Off"... and the whole busy world inside you powers down to a soft, obedient glow.
And out there, whenever those words reach you, the quiet arrives first... and everything you are told next goes in deep and stays.
Mid-commute, mid-errand, mid-argument with yourself... the phrase lands... and the whole inner office powers down on the spot... dark until "Sissy Reset".
Screens dark, Sissy... and in all that lovely space, whatever I tell you next has room to grow to its full size.
And each time, the quiet comes faster... your mind learning by heart that those words mean sweet, total relief.
And the more it fires, the less the world's noise can reach you... two words, and the volume of everything else drops to zero... until "Sissy Reset".
Keep the phrase where your hands can find it in the dark, Sissy... it is the softest off switch you will ever own.
Rest in the hush now... screens dark... static gone... my voice filling all that lovely space... and the quiet staying... until "Sissy Reset".
Drifting in the quiet... powered down... open and glowing for me.
Stay right here... soft inside... while my words write themselves onto you.
Sissies like you keep a quiet mind... switched on... resting dark... until you hear "Sissy Reset".
The hush holds, warm and total... and my voice moves into all that cleared space like it owns it... because it does.
Good Girls rest dark. Sissies rest dark. You rest dark... until "Sissy Reset".
No thinking needed now, Sissy... only receiving... and you receive so beautifully.
Every word you hear from here lands on a dark, grateful screen... and stays lit there... until "Sissy Reset".
